best_section.where: opposite the tennis/sports courts, near the south end of the first chunk just before the oval frontage begins

drivers.road: Service-style road through a sports/college precinct, not a residential through route, though signed 50 km/h with 3 lanes nearby towards Sir Fred Schonell Drive.
drivers.room_and_convention: Cars already line the kerb the whole way past the courts and oval, and 'P (No Limit)' signs confirm all-day legal parking.
drivers.houses: No house fronts this stretch — it backs onto sports courts/oval, with the nearest residential buildings set well back behind the courts.

flags: Gentle uphill grade (~2%) through the best section, steepening to over 7% further south
Dense tree canopy along the building side may limit mobile signal/visibility of the sky
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy on the building (east) side shades the kerb through most of the morning; the sports courts/oval to the west are open, so afternoon sun reaches the van.
cannot_judge: Whether painted parking bays exist at this exact spot (markings only clearly visible further south in chunk 2)
summary: Quiet kerb beside sports courts with cars already parked, but it's part of a 50 km/h, multi-lane precinct road.
reasons: Backs onto sports courts, not houses
Parked cars show kerbside parking is normal
